item.question: What challenges do reinforcement learning agents face when trained offline in multi-agent systems?
item.answer: Offline training of reinforcement learning agents in multi-agent systems is challenging due to the lack of agent-resolved data, making it difficult to infer individual states and directly use available information. This complexity is heightened in competitive environments like financial markets.
